descriptor.scope: Bounded Lenasia technical review of the national Chief Surveyor-General Erven reference layer hosted by DFFE. Whole native polygons and PRCL_KEY identity are preserved. Wider city coverage, legal title, survey accuracy and currentness are unverified.

evidence: First-party DFFE service metadata identifies the source as "National Cadastral Layer. Custodian - Chief Surveyor General"; layer 2 publishes Erven polygon boundaries with native PRCL_KEY and OBJECTID. See evidence/official-source-inspection.json and https://dffeportal.environment.gov.za/hosting/rest/services/CSG_Cadaster/CSG_Cadastral_Data/MapServer?f=pjson.

The frozen city packet and service review record complete bounded envelope queries around the unchanged Lenasia locator, returning the two native PRCL_KEY samples. The national first-party layer extent includes that location; sample-file SHA-256 matches the frozen queue. This establishes local sampled scope, not citywide completeness. See evidence/input-provenance.json.
